questions.question: Distinguish between a thick lens and a thin lens.
questions.solution_html:

  • two surfaces. (2) The distances of objects and images from the lens.

  • negligible compared to the radii of curvature of those surfaces. Essentially, its thickness is significant
  • compared to its focal length.
